\f[faceWally]\bOh! Um… hello!
\f[faceWally]\bI’m Wally… the Gym Leader.
\f[faceWally]\bNorman isn’t leading the Gym right now, so… I’m filling in.
\f[faceWally]\bI know, it surprises people.
\f[faceWally]\bI'm keeping this Gym traditions, so I just use Normal-type Pokémon.
\f[faceWally]\bThey’re strong when you raise them with care.
\f[faceWally]\bI’m still getting used to standing here as a Gym Leader.
\f[faceWally]\bBut when a Trainer comes to challenge me...\n I want to answer them seriously.
\f[faceWally]\bOkay...\nLet's battle!

then.text: \f[faceWally]\bYou're really strong.\nAnd… the way you battle, it’s steady.
\f[faceWally]\bI’m glad you challenged me.\nIt helps me understand what I still need to work on.
\PN received the Balance Badge from Wally!
\f[faceWally]\bWith this Badge you are now allowed to take Pokémon from other regions from your Box, up to level 15.
\f[faceWally]\bAnd this is my gift for you.
\f[faceWally]\bIt's a restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
\f[faceWally]\bI couldn't beat you today. But one of these days, I'll catch up to you!

list.text: \f[faceWally]\bI couldn't beat you. But one of these days, I'll catch up to you!
